name: Deep Research
title: Deep Research | Amplifier Smart Tools
description: Turn an open question into a concise brief with sources you can follow. Deep Research gathers evidence, synthesizes the findings, and keeps the full record for the next question.
caption: Workflow illustration.
flow_title: From question to a sourced answer.
flow_intro: Turn an open question into a concise brief with sources you can follow. Deep Research gathers evidence, synthesizes the findings, and keeps the full record for the next question.
steps: Describe the decision, topic, or uncertainty you want to investigate.
Research across sources and connect the findings into a concise brief.
Read the retained report, inspect citations, and export a bibliography.
detail_title: Expertise your agent can put to work.
details: Ask what is known, where sources disagree, and what matters to your choice.
Sources and reports stay on disk so later questions can build on earlier work.
Read bounded sections, filter sources, and render retained reports without another model call.
prompt: Use Deep Research to investigate my question. Read deep-research --help, check configuration, and estimate the work before starting. Return a concise brief with citations and a pointer to the retained evidence.
prerequisites: Python 3.12+ and uv. Follow the configuration guide to select an evidence backend and model provider.
model_note: Research uses configured evidence and model services. Reading, filtering, and rendering retained runs need no model call.
